title: Caye Caulker MIMES integrated output — clade × depth-bin detail
description: Per-polygon ecosystem clade percentage broken down by depth bin for Caye Caulker MIMES integrated output. Joined to `cayecaulker-site` (the 9-polygon CayeCaulker.shp) by `MIMES_ID` — both this CSV and `cayecaulker-mimes-nbs-scores.csv` have 9 distinct Polygon_IDs (1–9), which exactly matches CayeCaulker.shp's MIMES_ID range. The narrower `cayecaulker-marine-polygons` (CC_Marine.shp) only covers the marine subset (MIMES_ID 4–9) and would drop polygons 1–3.
